mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained PCE growth, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a single month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.1 percentage points, signals a strong demand environment and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPI) over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods with sustained CPI growth, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a single month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strong labor market and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained GDP growth, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
